product.name: Location Data Services
product.description: Provides processed location data linked to mobile advertising IDs to analyze consumer attendance and behavior at physical locations and events.

product.name: Geofencing and Venue Analytics
product.description: Creates virtual boundaries around locations of interest to track and analyze mobile device visits and infer user preferences and activities.

product.name: Audience Segmentation and Personas
product.description: Segments mobile device users into interest-based groups to support targeted advertising and marketing campaigns.

product.name: Advertising Attribution and Campaign Measurement
product.description: Tracks whether devices exposed to ads visit specific locations to measure advertising campaign performance.

identifier.value: Consumer Behavior and Competitive Intelligence Analytics

product.name: Consumer Behavior and Competitive Intelligence Analytics
product.description: Generates insights and trends about consumer behaviors and competitor customer bases using location data.
